question: Which Paralympic swimmer won a Laureus award in 2025 for disability sport?
solution: The correct answer is __**Jiang Yuyan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** • **Jiang Yuyan**, the remarkable **Chinese Paralympic swimmer**, was named the winner of the **Laureus World Sportsperson of the Year with a Disability** award in **2025**. • This prestigious recognition was bestowed upon her following her historic performance at the **Paris 2024 Paralympic Games**, where she emerged as the most successful athlete of the entire event. • At the **Paris 2024** games, she won a total of **7 gold medals**, a feat that solidified her status as a global icon in disability sports. • Her gold medal haul included victories in events such as the **50m freestyle S6**, **100m freestyle S6**, **400m freestyle S6**, and **50m butterfly S6**, along with relay successes. • The **Laureus World Sports Awards**, often referred to as the "Oscars of Sport," celebrate the greatest sporting achievements from the preceding year (**2024**) during their **2025** ceremony. ***Hence, the correct answer is Jiang Yuyan.***
